name: Prism
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode where the diagonals hold the power. Runs of four or more count on the diagonals too, and every diagonal run forges a flame gem, which blows up the 3 x 3 square around it when it goes; straight runs only score, however long. Eight kinds of gem on a 10 x 10 board. Runs that cross join into an L, T or plus for a bonus, blasts set off the power gems they hit, and cascades forge them too. Uses its own high-score table. Turn on one game mode at a time.
